name: spec-architect
description: The five-stage spec pipeline: constitution, spec, tasks, implement, drift.

plugins.name: spec-architect
plugins.description: The five-stage spec pipeline for Claude Code. spec-constitution sets the repository's rules, spec-architect writes the spec and its acceptance criteria, spec-tasks turns it into an ordered list, spec-implement executes one task at a time verifying each against the criteria it cites, and spec-drift audits the result. The AC-### identifiers are what join them: assigned once, cited by every later stage.
